sunil.note: ADR-030 §5 role 2 — n8n is a CONNECTOR FABRIC reached through the governed chokepoint. Every tool this workflow advertises must also appear in config/tools.yaml with a permission row, or it does not exist to SUNIL (ADR-034). authentication MUST stay 'bearerAuth': 'none' is the node default and would publish this endpoint to anything that can reach the port (docs/tasks/S2-E-n8n.md §4).

parameters.instructions: SUNIL's own governed action surface. Only the tools declared in SUNIL's config/tools.yaml are callable; anything else advertised here is ignored by the client.

nodes.name: MCP Server Trigger
nodes.notes: The bearer value lives in n8n's encrypted credential vault, never in this file. scripts/n8n-setup.* creates it from SUNIL_N8N_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN and substitutes the id on import.

parameters.description: Record a short status update against a Codely project. Returns the stored update as structured data.

nodes.name: post_update
nodes.notes: The NODE NAME is the MCP tool name from toolCode v1.2 onward, and it must match config/tools.yaml exactly — the adapter's startup drift check (ADR-034) refuses to start if it does not.
